You've seen him at the Ruined Temple...\nHe's Cipiwon, the leader of Resistle undercover\nagents.
You are...
What happened? Don't say you...
Hell no! We're just taking care of him.\nHe was seriously injured and nearly eaten by\nmonsters!
...Hm. Come to think of it, you helped us at the\ntemple. You won't do anything like this.\nI'm sorry. I was wrong.
Recently, Straye soldiers are frequently attacked\nnear here, so we are on high alert.
Forgive my rudeness.\nAnd thanks for saving the injured.
Hmm, again...\nAll the victims so far are axe users.
Axe?? Why...?
It's a mystery. We have no clue who the culprit is\nand what the motive is... At this rate, the number\nof victims will continue to increase...
We would appreciate if you could cooperate with\nus for the investigation.
...Oh, Pino requested you to do that?\nThat's great. Thanks in advance.
Resistle will take good care of the injured.
Oh, how did it go? ...I see.\nSo, the culprit wasn't in the highlands...
I'd like you to continue the investigation in\nother places. Is that alright for you?
I appreciate your help.\nLet's call it a day. Have a good rest.
Ruzart!\nYou're a disgrace to the undercover agent unit...!\nNo, you're a disgrace to the Resistle!
How dare you attack innocent people to try your\nskill?!
Huh! Shut up, moron.
You didn't notice that it was me all this time?
How can you still act like you know it all?!
What did you say...?
You're not even sorry for what you've done?!\nAnd you're insulting your superior?! ...You don't\ndeserve to be a soldier! I'll execute you right...
Wait. Don't execute him...
Execution is one of the ways for soldiers to be\nresponsible for their fault...\nThis man doesn't even deserve it.
Ruzart...I, Cipiwon hereby sentence you in the\nname of the leader of Resistle Undercover Agents.
You are banished.
What...?!
Banished...\nRuzart looks astonished to hear that.\nIt must be something unusual...
B-Banished?? What does that mean?
...Banished means to be expelled from the\nfaction.
Banishment will be widely announced, so he won't\nbe able to join the other factions either nor receive\nany support. He's gonna be cast adrift...
He will be shamed, rejected and criticized for\nthe rest of his life...
It's much more disgraceful than execution for\na proud soldier...
Begone...
A... Agggghhhhh!!
Was it right? He has done something unforgivable\nbut banishment is a bit too...
That was right. No matter how many hard times\nwe’ve gone through together, he has done the worst\nthing as a soldier, a human being rather.
He has hurt many innocent people.\nIf I had mercy on him, I wouldn't be able to face\nthe victims...
I apologize for causing you trouble.\nAnd I appreciate your help as the leader of the\nundercover agents.
The Gate of Another World is ahead of the manor.\nYou should stay alert...
Whoa! No!
Ah! What happened?!
You forgot?! We've gotta report that we've\ngot rid of the monsters before sunset! Otherwise,\nwe can't get anything from the greedy merchant!
Oh, no! We need to hurry...\nSee you.
You'd better hurry too.\nYou don't wanna work with no pay, do you?\nTake care.
Oh, dang!\nWe've gotta go back right now.\nHurry!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing!
Explore here a little longer.
